collection_checks.meaning: Source integrity and syntax; arbitrary regex overlaps and actual iOS behavior are not proven.

shared_quality_policy.json_failure_guard: Preserve original JSON on a jq error, zero outputs or multiple outputs; retain successful single outputs.
shared_quality_policy.binding_composition: Only consecutive local replies or script bindings with identical hostname scope and behavior/options are combined; intervening priority and original script bytes remain unchanged.

source_integrity: Original source archives and upstream script byte suffixes are preserved; compatibility wrappers are separate. Mirror blob checks do not independently prove equality with the official origin.
delivery_mode: Per-App native alternatives remain selected; full aggregate is disabled there to prevent duplicate processing. Aggregate is an independently checked optional alternative, not a guarantee of iOS effect.
limitations: Catalog records include duplicate variants and download failures; this is not a count of working unique plugins.
Unsupported operations, invalid jq, unavailable dependencies, same-App owners and shared hosts remain explicitly excluded from collection extensions.
Whole-regex conflict freedom, current App response schema, countdown removal and certificate-pinned traffic require device evidence.
No new benchmark score or live DNS/WebRTC leakage result was measured.
